answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation (using AMT workers) to evaluate the quality of the actor groups ... In a blind survey, MTurk workers choose the best of three partitionings -B1, B2 and TAMPA of actors into groups.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdsourced annotators were asked to compare three partitionings of actors and select the most appropriate grouping; they also classified pairs of actors as aligned or disaligned.
